integrity: Exact symbolic polynomial and rational-matrix checker supplied; symbolic identities, height computations and determinant certificates were reproduced from included files. Independent review and validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Arithmetic ranks and conjugation eigendimensions for one explicit elliptic curve over Q(v,t); does not provide saturated arithmetic generators, an integral basis, or arithmetic ranks over other number fields. Geometric rank bound is taken from Burek (2026).
title: Arithmetic Mordell–Weil rank eight for Burek's elliptic Calabi–Yau threefold
